card.name: Linking words in drug transporter lists
card.fires_on: The word "and", a comma, or "including" that follows a drug transporter name (OCT2, MATE1, BCRP, OATP1B1) in a drug interaction list. It expects another transporter name next.

modes.label: After a transporter abbreviation
modes.description: An "and" or comma right after a transporter abbreviation such as OCT2, BCRP or MATE1 in a list of substrates.

modes.label: After enzymes or transporters generally
modes.description: "and" or "including" after the general word transporters or after enzymes, leading into specific transporter names.
